summary: Both color counts are capped at 100, and the accepted formula uses a fixed number of integer-square-root and arithmetic operations; the complete 10,000-pair domain is too small for an honest runtime-scaling verdict.

replacement_checks.evidence: For each of the two possible starting colors, the accepted implementation inverts the odd- and even-row sums with exactly two integer-square-root calls, then combines the four resulting bounds with fixed arithmetic.
The certificate regression checks all 10,000 legal ordered (red, blue) pairs against an independent row-by-row simulator that tries both starting colors.
